details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{sd}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{VC}(\mathcal H)-1$.
proof: A shattered $d$-set yields the boundary of the $d$-dimensional cross-polytope as an antipodal simplicial $(d-1)$-sphere in the realizable-distribution complex, as shown in Lemma 2 of the cited paper.
name: Spherical Dimension / VC Dimension (affine)
witness_verification: For the family #classes/universal_class with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $\mathrm{sd}\ge n-2$ and $\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
